answer: Agents resist sybils by binding each identity to a non-shareable garden of sequential zenith proofs on a mesa of private challenges. Every identity keeps a live working-set of prior garden states that a zenith auditor samples. An attacker with 25 clones must hold 25 separate memory gardens because mesa challenges differ per identity and cannot be pooled%2C costing ~25× the RAM and sequential compute of one honest agent reusing a single garden. Honest agents pay only base cost%3B fails if mesa challenges leak early.
